custom_instruments.Definition

This class defines parameters for streaming custom instruments

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    universe: StrStrings,
    fields: OptStrStrs = None,
    api: OptStr = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe StrStrings Yes The Id or Symbol of custom instrument to operate on.
fields OptStrStrs No None Specifies the specific fields to be delivered when messages arrive
api OptStr No None Specifies the data source. It can be updated/added using config file
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters

Methods

get_stream

Returns a stream of the custom instruments defined by this Definition.

get_stream(session=None) -> Stream

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Stream

Example

from lseg.data.content.custom_instruments import Definition
definition = Definition(universe="S)MyNewInstrument")
stream = definition.get_stream()
stream.open()
